newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics cuts price on Pilot products.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics cuts price on Pilot products.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Tuesday it reduced the suggested retail price for the holiday season of Pilot, a line of handheld connected organizers designed to work as companion products to desktop or laptop computers.

The Pilot 1000 will carry a suggested price of $249, down from $299, and the Pilot 5000 will carry a suggested price of $299, down from $369. The product line combines a date book, address book, to-do list, calculator, and note-taking applications with connecting software.

"Our retailers and reseller partners have had great success with Pilot this year, and this new holiday season price should make this a rich selling season for Pilot," said Ed Colligan, vice president of marketing of Palm Computing, Inc, a subsidiary of U.S. Robotics.
Pilot is distributed through consumer electronics and office supply stores nationwide.
